name: robotics/maintenance-authority
definition: Subject may push firmware, configuration and key rotation.
title: Maintenance authority
description: Required for ATEP-R maintenance commands, which fail closed on a stale or missing revocation list.
subject: Agent ID of the maintainer
attestation-schema:
attestation = {
  subject: agent-id,
  issuer: agent-id,                      ; MUST equal the envelope signer
  claim: uri,
  data: { * tstr => any },
  ? evidence: bstr .size 32,
  ? evidence-uri: uri,
  id: bstr .size 16,
}
agent-id = bstr .size 32
uri = tstr
lifetime: 30 to 180 days by default, 400 days at most
